subject.title: feat(gateway): wire read coding tool into HTTP /tools/invoke (narrow)

question: After fixing same-named plugin compatibility, should OpenClaw core permit owner-authenticated direct invocation of the built-in host-filesystem `read` tool behind both explicit config gates?
rationale: This intentionally expands authenticated data access to host-file contents; implementation correctness and test proof cannot decide the accepted product/security boundary.

options.title: Accept after compatibility fix
options.body: Approve the narrow default-off owner-only reader after source-aware plugin handling and refreshed exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep built-in reads agent-only
options.body: Reject direct built-in host reads and retain existing plugin or integration surfaces for deterministic access.

recommendation.title: Accept after compatibility fix
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow default-off owner-only reader after source-aware plugin handling and refreshed exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev tightened and merged the shared invocation contract and is the strongest individual owner to coordinate the security-team decision.
